negative_snippets:
Extremely disappointing stay. The photos are completely misleading, reality is nothing like what’s advertised. The room was ridiculously small, cramped, and smelled terrible the moment we entered. Everything felt old, poorly maintained, and low quality.
The kitchen was dirty and unhygienic, with stained utensils that were honestly disgusting 🤢. The TV was a cheap, low-grade brand with terrible sound and picture quality. Even basic amenities were a joke, the hair dryer looked third-hand, and despite turning on the geyser 40 minutes in advance, the water was still ice cold.
Overall, this was easily the worst BNB experience I’ve had. I have no idea how this place has good reviews. Definitely not worth the money and not recommended at all.
The host was rude and abusive. He made false allegations of bribery when i gave him a rating of 1 on Airbnb for shitty service
